historical_record.description: Recorded in the city's survey of the Van Ness Avenue automobile corridor as built for use as an auto repair shop. A small shop, plain but for a shaped parapet recalling the Mission Revival manner. Auto repair shops worked here for 44 years.
Evaluated in the city's survey of the Van Ness Avenue automobile corridor and given California Register status code 3CS — individually eligible for the California Register, under Criterion 1.
